question: RQ8: do simulator policy conclusions (M7, original regime) agree with bounded historical execution?

mapping.source: development period only (deribit-eth-perp-2020-04-01) versus the M7 original regime
mapping.clock_ratio: historical seconds per simulated second = simulated top-of-book change rate / historical top-of-book change rate (lob.observables_v2 on 100 ms tapes)
mapping.lot_scale: lots per native unit = simulated median top-5 side depth (lots) / historical median top-5 side depth (native)
mapping.applied_unchanged_to: every M8 dataset including BTC (a transfer test)

episodes.start: dataset first capture time + 300 s + k * 600 s, k = 0..143
episodes.window: (warmup + horizon + settlement timeout) simulated seconds mapped by the clock ratio
episodes.time_base: provider local capture timestamps for book and prints

replay: lob.historical_sim.HistoricalSimulator: displayed levels as identity-free liquidity reset to history at every update (no market impact); own marketable orders walk displayed levels only; own resting orders fill only from lob.fill_bounds trackers; no exact FIFO

policies.learned: main-arm PPO and DQN checkpoints of every M7 training seed, unchanged, with the M7 sealed normalization
policies.ac_parameters: M7 evaluation-lock selection for the original regime

comparisons.pairs: PPO vs each control, DQN vs each control, PPO vs DQN (learned values averaged over training seeds per episode)
comparisons.synthetic_reference: M7 original-regime mean paired cost difference and its registered interval
comparisons.historical: per dataset and fill mode: mean paired episode cost difference with percentile bootstrap (5000 resamples, seed 48901), Bonferroni over pairs x datasets x modes

classification.agrees_survives_conservative: historical interval excludes zero in the synthetic direction under both fill modes
classification.optimistic_assumption_dependent: same-direction exclusion under the optimistic mode only
classification.reverses: opposite-direction exclusion under both fill modes
classification.not_evaluable: missing or INVALID outcomes in either mode, or no synthetic comparison

also_reported: synthetic and historical rankings per mode with Kendall tau
within-horizon and settlement completion per mode
regime sensitivity using the frozen M6 thresholds
